pair_rest.words: dancing swing with a partner who stands just outside the picture on the picture-right side, her body turned three-quarters toward the picture-right and looking that way with a warm smile, knees soft. Her picture-right arm reaches out to the picture-right side at chest height, nearly straight, the hand open and clearly visible, as if holding her partner's hand. Her picture-left hand rests on her picture-left hip with the elbow out. Weight on her picture-left leg, her picture-right foot a small step forward.

spin_reach.words: in a deep playful curtsey, reaching down to hold the hand of a very tiny toy robot who stands outside the picture on the picture-right side. Her knees are deeply bent, her torso leans over toward the picture-right, and her picture-right arm stretches straight down and outward to the lower picture-right, the hand very low, at the height of her knee and well clear of her skirt, clearly visible. Her picture-left arm lifts out to the picture-left for balance. Her head tilts down toward the lower picture-right with a delighted smile. Her skirt covers her legs to below the knee.

pair_rest_b.words: dancing swing with a partner who stands just outside the picture on the picture-right side, her body turned three-quarters toward the picture-right and looking that way with a warm smile. Her picture-right arm reaches out to the picture-right side at chest height, nearly straight, the hand open and clearly visible, as if holding her partner's hand. She leans back away from her partner with her weight on her back picture-left leg, knees soft, her picture-right foot forward with its toe lifted, her skirt swinging toward the picture-right. Her picture-left hand rests on her picture-left hip with the elbow out.

pair_arm.words: dancing swing with a partner who stands just outside the picture on the picture-right side, her body turned three-quarters toward the picture-right and looking that way with a warm smile. Her picture-right arm reaches out to the picture-right side at chest height, nearly straight, the hand open and clearly visible, as if holding her partner's hand. Her other arm, the picture-left one, is thrown high up in the air and out to the picture-left, straight with the open hand above her head, joyful. Weight on both feet, knees soft.

pair_kick.words: dancing swing with a partner who stands just outside the picture on the picture-right side, her body turned three-quarters toward the picture-right and looking that way with a warm smile. Her picture-right arm reaches out to the picture-right side at chest height, nearly straight, the hand open and clearly visible, as if holding her partner's hand. She stands on her straight picture-right leg and her picture-left leg kicks out low to the picture-left side with the toe pointed, the skirt swinging with it and still covering her legs to below the knee. Her picture-left hand rests on her picture-left hip with the elbow out.
